outside_family.issue: FparetoResult borrows Gb2Status and forwards the delegated status, but its outcome switch has no case for the new Gb2Status::Unbounded.
outside_family.required: The owning batch must map Gb2Status::Unbounded to nonexistence(Unbounded), and transport the new GB2 face payloads with the held threshold. This job does not edit fpareto.
outside_family.evidence: The delegated result is returned with r.status at line 41; the outcome switch at lines 58-75 has no Unbounded case.
outside_family.build_evidence: Confirmed by the successful workstation Emscripten build: js-build.log reports -Wswitch at fpareto/mle.hpp:58 for Gb2Status::Unbounded.

shared_registry.required: Add generic model identifiers/coefficient metadata and strict density-law registrations if these payloads are to be evaluated by the shared density judge. This job supplies the named payload and checks the double-Pareto density independently; the translated Pareto payload has an R density regression.

judge_ratchet.issue: A prior density:limit key is not marked judged when the new terminal outcome has no density item. Official --prune therefore cannot remove the two corrected Lomax entries.
judge_ratchet.workaround: prune-unrepresentable-face.py verifies only those original keys, proves the exact rate exceeds DBL_MAX, verifies the final evaluation-failure outcome and empty invalid-face payload, then deletes the obsolete entries.

shared_capability_catalogue.issue: With obsolete frontend holds guards removed, the generated GPD/Pareto4 capabilities.csv rows default to implemented even for runtime unsupported held slices. A held-name mask alone cannot express their value-dependent existence decisions.
shared_capability_catalogue.required: Keep core decisions authoritative. Extend shared capability metadata to distinguish a core-delegated request from a guarantee that every held-value slice is implemented; do not restore broad frontend guards.
